title: The World's Root
text: A root of some impossible tree, as wide as a castle, curves out of the ground and back in. Sap like amber oozes from a wound in its side. Tiny figures are caught in the sap like flies, and some of them are still moving.

options.label: The Leader collects the sap without looking too closely at what is caught in it.

outcomes.text: It is amber that never sets. You try not to look at what is in it.

options.label: The strongest climbs into the wound to learn what lives inside the root.

outcomes.text: Inside it is warm and alive, and it gives them something.
Inside it is warm and alive, and hungry.

options.label: Bind the wound with what cloth you have so the root may heal.

outcomes.text: The root shudders. Somewhere far off, a tree sighs.
